text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — CI microbench on PR #14002 shows a ~25% tail-lat regression for 4k seq tests after the scheduler change. Failing job: https://ci.internal/reports/14002/artifact
Jonas Patel: Ugh. Is this the kernel routing tweak you landed yesterday? /cc @Kai
Kai Nguyen: Yep, the change to the routing heuristic landed in the patch. I saw some odd locality flips locally but didn't get that size of regression.
Maria Chen: Perf snapshot from CI (summary):
```
microbench.generate(seq=4096) baseline: p95=110ms p99=210ms
PR-14002: p95=130ms p99=265ms  (p99 +26%)
KV hitrate: baseline=87% PR=64%
```
perf-bot: Attached artifact: s3://perf-artifacts/14002/snapshot.json (metrics + flamegraphs)
Jonas Patel: KV hitrate drop is suspicious. Could this be batching change interacting with KV eviction?
@Kai any smoke reproductions with the new batch sampler enabled?
Kai Nguyen: I ran a local run on a dev box (A100, same model). With `--batch-sampler=v2` I can reproduce a ~15% p99 bump and a 20% drop in synchronous KV hits. Looks like sampler spreads requests across more kernels, reducing KV locality.
Ashley Rivera: Does this block release? If KV hit drops that much we'll pay large tail costs. Recommend hold rollout of the scheduler heuristic until we understand.
Maria Chen: Agreed. Marking PR as rollback-candidate. I'm holding the canary rollout. @ci-bot can you prevent the merge train for this PR from auto-promoting?
ci-bot: Noted. Auto-promote disabled for PR #14002. Job reruns will still run on request.
Jonas Patel: Can we narrow this to the sampler <-> kernel-affinity interaction? If so we could revert the sampler change only.
Kai Nguyen: Initial bisect points to the sampler commit + the scheduler affinity refactor having a combined effect. Separately, each gives ~5-10% noise; together it's multiplicative. Will run a quick two-commit bisect tonight.
Maria Chen: If bisect confirms the interaction, propose: revert sampler v2 in main, keep scheduler refactor. Less blast radius. Thoughts?
Ashley Rivera: +1 to narrow revert. Also please add a small smoke guard in CI to detect KV hitrate drops >10% on microbench so we catch earlier.
Jonas Patel: Good idea. I'll draft a perf-gate PR that checks the KV hitrate metric and fails CI if p99 reg > 15% or KV hit delta > 10% vs baseline.
perf-bot: Suggestion: add a warmup stage in the microbench workflow to stabilize KV warmstart variance (30s warmup). That reduces flakiness and makes diffs more actionable.
Kai Nguyen: Thanks — I'll run the bisect and upload traces. If anyone has repro scripts, ping me and I'll run them across the commit boundary.
Maria Chen: Thanks team. Holding rollout and adding rollback label on the PR. I'll post updates once bisect completes. :raised_hands:
ci-bot: Re-run requested by Kai Nguyen — queued job 14002-try1.
Artifact: https://ci.internal/jobs/14002-try1/logs
Jonas Patel: Ping if you need infra support for local repro (extra sized KV cache).

(End of thread)
